articles.summary: Parasite elimination achieved with 28-day treatment in 100% of nonhuman primates (NHPs) naturally infected with Trypanosoma cruzi (T. cruzi) at target exposures planned in humans Phase 1 First-In-Human (FIH) study showed favorable safety and tolerability profile; no dose-limiting toxicities
articles.title: AN2 Therapeutics Reports Positive Enabling Data Supporting Advancement of Oral AN2-502998 to Phase 2 Study for Chronic Chagas Disease
